title: PCA & Principal Components Lab
refinements: Use canonical shared shell, compact progress, controls and one Guide invitation.
Raster chart is illustrative: engine provides an exact square equal-scale plot and all marks.
Current rotated axes are called manual unless aligned with computed principal directions.
One native angle editor/slider, one retained-component toggle and PC1 alignment action; no point dragging.
Covariance and variance use divisor3; mean squared reconstruction error divisor4.
Preserve every original identity and mark in exact table and grouped coincident glyphs.
Undefined variance ratios remain explicit at zero total variance; equal eigenvalues give no unique PC1.
Open summary columns and plain supporting construction replace any generated container variations.
